scripts.test:unit: vitest run && cd .. && python -m pytest backend/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider -rfEs
scripts.test:smoke: cd .. && python -m pytest backend/tests -m live_smoke -q -p no:cacheprovider -rfEs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:live: cd .. && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_live.py -m "bedrock_live or urimalsaem_live" -p no:cacheprovider -rs
scripts.test:env: cd .. && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_pg_startup.py -m env_robustness -q -p no:cacheprovider -rfEs
